info.name: CaseMate API
info.description:
Requests for the CaseMate API, with a test script on every request.

Run the folders from **Health** to **Cleanup** in order (Collection Runner, or
`npx newman run`). A run signs up a fresh test account, switches its email and SMS
reminders off (so the scheduler never messages it), exercises every module, checks
the error responses, then deletes the account and a second account it creates, so
nothing is left behind.

The session is an httpOnly cookie set by Sign up and Log in; Postman keeps it and
sends it with every later request.

Dates are worked out before each request, in IST, relative to now (see the
collection pre-request script). The "heard today" hearing is at 11:59 PM IST, so
avoid running the collection in the last minute of the day.

**Sends real messages (run manually)** is not part of the run order. Its requests
send real email or SMS; run them one at a time, after Invoices and before Cleanup.
See docs/api-reference.md for every endpoint.

exec: // IST calendar days relative to now, "yyyy-MM-dd", for request bodies.
const istDay = (days) => new Date(Date.now() + IST + days * DAY).toISOString().slice(0, 10);

item.name: Sends real messages (run manually)
item.description:
Not part of the run order: each request here sends a real email or SMS through the
server's SMTP and Twilio settings. Run them one at a time, while logged in, after the
Invoices folder and before Cleanup.

- Test reminder: one email to the account address and one SMS to {{phone}}. Set
  `emailBase` and `phone` in the environment to your own before signing up.
- Send invoice: emails the invoice PDF to the client (ramesh.gupta@example.com in
  this collection; change the client email to one you own first).
- Forgot password: emails a reset link if the address has an account.

item.name: Send me a test reminder (real email + SMS)

request.description: Sends one real email and one real SMS. Limited to 5 an hour per account.
Emails the PDF to the client. Fails with 409 for a paid invoice, 502 if the email cannot be sent.

exec: pm.test('same answer for any address', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('If an account exists for that email, we have sent a link to reset the password.'));

request.description: Always answers the same way; emails a reset link only if the account exists.
